note: Money mule setup: receive client payments in your own bank account, Zelle the rest onward, keep a cut.
text:
Hello,

We are hiring a part-time Payment Coordinator for Cedarpoint Trading. Work from home, 5 hours a week, no experience needed. You will use your personal bank account to receive client payments. Then transfer the remaining balance to our supplier through Zelle and keep $200 as your commission.

Recruiting
